description_en: Creates or modifies an asynchronous invocation configuration for a function

kebab_example: aliyun fc-open put-function-async-invoke-config --service-name demo-service --function-name helloworld --qualifier test --destination-config example-string --max-async-event-age-in-seconds 300 --max-async-retry-attempts 3 --stateful-invocation true --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id ksdfjkdmkki000 --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en: The maximum validity period of a message. Valid values: [1,604800]. Default value: 86400. Unit: seconds

parameters.help_en: Optional. The maximum number of retries if an asynchronous invocation fails. Valid values: [0,8]. If you do not configure this parameter, the default number of retries is 3
parameters.help_zh: 异步调用失败后的最大重试次数，非必填。取值范围[0,8]。当您未进行配置时，系统内部默认重试次数为3
parameters.name: max_async_retry_attempts
